title: 公認心理師の職責
subtitle: Professionalism of Licensed Psychologists
keywords: Role of Licensed Psychologists 2.Legal Obligations and Ethics of Licensed Psychologists 3.Ability to identify and solve own problems 4.Preparation for lifelong learning 5.Multi-professional collaboration and community collaboration
educationalGoal: In this course, students will understand the following: 1. role of licensed psychologists, 2. legal obligations and ethics of licensed psychologists, 3. ensuring the safety of those who need psychological support, 4. appropriate handling of information, 5. specific tasks of licensed psychologists in health care, welfare, education, and other fields, 6. Ability to find and solve problems, 7 Preparation for lifelong learning, 8 Multi-professional collaboration and community collaboration.
advice: In the course, students will learn to take initiative about the items 1-8 listed in the learning objectives above. In this lecture, students will learn about the background and legal position of the national qualification of licensed psychologist, and the roles and legal obligations of licensed psychologists. This lecture will take the form of multiple lecturers explaining each area.
requiredKnowledge: This course is required to obtain the national certification as a licensed psychologist. Students must have completed all courses for licensed psychologists offered by the third year.

activityGoals.body: Ability to state the four duties as defined in the Certified Psychologist Act.
Ability to give examples of the legal obligations set forth in the Certified Psychologist Act.
Ability to describe examples of multi-professional collaboration
